stations.stn_num: map-stations, chart-climate, chart-hot, chart-cold, chart-gradient, chart-rain-max, chart-radiation — joins station names to every data file
stations.stn_name: skip: English twin of stn_name_heb; searchable in the explorer
stations.stn_name_heb: map-stations, chart-climate, chart-hot, chart-cold, chart-gradient, chart-rain-max, chart-radiation, chart-elevation
stations.stn_lat: map-stations, chart-gradient, chart-climate — climatology stations are picked evenly by latitude
stations.isr_grid_X: skip: Israel-grid twin of stn_long; the map uses WGS84
stations.isr_grid_Y: skip: Israel-grid twin of stn_lat; the map uses WGS84
stations.stn_auto: insight:network — share of automatic stations among active ones
stations.stn_num_env: skip: cross-reference id into the separate ten-minute dataset
stations.date_web_frst: skip: publication start date, duplicates date_open for analysis
stations.date_web_last: chart-network, kpi:span — latest year of the network series
stations.yearly_rain: skip: flag marking totalizer gauges; the totalizer file itself is charted
daily.time_obs: chart-anomaly, chart-hotdays, chart-climate, chart-phenomena, chart-hot, chart-cold
daily.tmp_air_max: chart-anomaly, chart-hotdays, chart-climate, chart-hot, kpi:hottest, kpi:anomaly, insight:warming
daily.tmp_grass_min: skip: ground-level minimum, 63% empty; not fetched to keep the export small
daily.evp_cls_a_06_next: skip: class-A pan evaporation, 72% empty and shrinking with manned stations
daily.evp_cls_a_code: skip: quality code of the skipped evaporation column
daily.sns_drt: skip: sunshine duration, 93% empty; radiation file covers sunlight
daily.rpr_lightening: skip: near-duplicate of rpr_thunder, which is charted
daily.rpr_gale: skip: gale flag is set on almost no days (under 0.5% of reports)
rain_monthly.time_obs: chart-rain-index, chart-rain-months, chart-rain-max — month and rain season (August to July)
rain_monthly.rain_code: skip: quality code; interpolated months are kept as published
rain_monthly.rain_max_code: chart-rain-max — records use code 0 (regular measurement) only, disclosed
radiation.rad_type: chart-radiation, chart-rad-hours — global radiation (type 15) only; direct/diffuse not charted
resource:e80b470f-fcbc-4987-a685-d4fbefb: skip: daily rain (1.99M rows, at the record cap); the monthly rain file carries the same totals, rain days and daily maxima
resource:c02e5c7d-0adb-4e04-a941-06e2811: skip: hourly data, 9.2M rows, over the refresh record cap; browsable in the explorer
